Legal

Privacy policy

How Justice Energy Co. collects, uses and protects information shared through this website. Last updated October 15, 2026.

Information we collect

When you submit our consultation form, we collect the details you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, property location, property type, services or programs of interest and any message you include.

Like most websites, our hosting provider may automatically record technical information such as your IP address, browser type, device type and pages visited. If analytics are enabled, we use them to understand how visitors use the site in aggregate.

How we use information

  • To respond to your consultation request and communicate with you about your project
  • To provide information about services and programs you asked about
  • To operate, maintain and improve this website
  • To comply with legal obligations and protect against fraud or misuse

How information is shared

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate the website and handle form submissions, and, with your permission, with programs you ask us to help you with. We may also disclose information when required by law.

Cookies and analytics

This website may use cookies or similar technologies needed for it to function and, if enabled, for analytics. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

Data retention and security

We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described above or as required by law, and we use reasonable safeguards to protect it. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

Your privacy rights

Depending on where you live, including California, you may have the right to request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal information, and to know how it is used. To make a request, contact us using the details below. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

Children's privacy

This website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last updated.
